name: theme-toggle
title: Theme Toggle
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A theme provider and toggle button that switch between light and dark with an animated circular reveal. The provider applies the `dark` class to the html element and stores the choice; the button cross-fades a sun and moon icon.
docs: Register the @spaceman namespace before installing: `npx shadcn@latest registry add @spaceman=https://spaceman.sh/r/{name}.json`. Wrap your app in <ThemeProvider> inside the root layout's <body>, and add suppressHydrationWarning to <html>. Your CSS needs a dark variant that matches the class, e.g. `@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *))` on Tailwind v4. The reveal runs at 300ms and is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
